name: FNF Week 6

comments.author: StalkingGriffin87

comments.content: OMG, this mod is so fun! The Senpai rap battle is classic, and the new songs in FNF Week 6 are absolute bangers! Thorns is fire!

userInputText:
A funny mod of Friday Night Funkin where Boyfriend rap-battle with Senpai in HD.

Also added 2 extra songs. One Remix and one Miku cover.

Songs:
Senpai
Roses
Thorns
Aishite-love-me (freeplay)
Roses-remix (freeplay)
Mod Credits:
If you had fun and would like to keep up-to-update on the mod, make sure to support mod creators on their social media by subscribing, following, liking, etc.
